target_customer: Advocacy groups and political organizations that want to influence primary elections
problem: Organizations did not know which of their members were reliable primary voters or who represented them, so they could not target primaries.
business_model: B2B software for political targeting, matching member lists to a voter file

founders.name: James Vaughan
founders.background_notes: Crunchbase names him co-founder and CEO. No background found.

founders.name: Can Sar
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page; no background found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Record matching of member lists against a purchased voter file plus a targeting interface, mostly data engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Depends on access to voter file data that incumbents such as NationBuilder and party vendors also had; no unique data was described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes any action by incumbents against this company.

market_need_then: A TechCrunch piece in the search results argued primary voters skew toward activists on the left and right, which supports the thesis, but no source shows paying demand from advocacy groups.

branding.domain_note: valuevoting.com did not resolve in this environment, which suggests the domain is dead or blocked.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, brand assets or community evidence was found; the name resembles unrelated values voter groups and trademarks.

outcome_analysis: YC lists Value Voting as inactive, and no article, post-mortem or funding record explains what happened. A failure-database page gave an end year of 2020 and a cash burn figure, but it describes a different product and contradicts itself, so it is not used. The cause of failure is not public and the failure factors stay empty.
notes: valuevoting.com failed to resolve, so the site is treated as dead. Loot-drop reports end year 2020 and 2.5M cash burned for a product described differently from YC; unreliable and not recorded as a round or exit date. Crunchbase shows no figures in the search snippet. Competitor search returned 2012 Votizen coverage and undated pages, none dated near the 2017 batch, so the competitor list is empty; the incumbents listed in takeover risk are general context, not sourced competitors. Founder backgrounds and education not found.
